export_row_layer.note: This is a separate row-wise serialization/export layer, not the same operation as live per-parameter quantization.

boundaries: Exact duplicate files are preservation copies, not independent models or experiments.
Memory-byte numbers are implementation estimates, not measured hardware RSS or latency gains.
Historical pickle files must never be loaded from untrusted sources.
A useful Slime trace is a heuristic importance signal, not biological evidence about slime molds.
